requirement.text: A visitor signs in with an email and a password.
While the credentials are being checked, the form is locked.
If the credentials are valid, the visitor is signed in and taken to their dashboard.
If the credentials are invalid, the visitor sees the reason and can try again.
After three failed attempts in a row, the visitor is locked out and must reset their password.
The sign-in page must load in under two seconds.

outOfScope.reason: A performance budget, not machine behaviour: checked by a Lighthouse threshold in CI, not by this workflow.

states.description: The form is shown and editable.
The form is locked while the credentials are verified.
The visitor has a session and is on the dashboard.
The reason is shown; the form is editable again.
No more attempts; only a password reset gets the visitor out.

functions.name: verifyCredentials
functions.output: Promise<{ ok: true; session: Session } | { ok: false; reason: string }>
functions.precondition: email and password are both non-empty strings.
functions.postcondition: Resolves { ok: true, session } when the pair matches an account; otherwise { ok: false, reason } with a reason that does not say which of the two was wrong.

functions.name: recordFailedAttempt
functions.precondition: attempts is a non-negative integer (0 before the first failure).
functions.postcondition: attempts is one higher than the input; exhausted is true exactly when the new count is 3 or more.

functions.name: openDashboard
functions.precondition: The session was just issued by verifyCredentials.
functions.postcondition: The browser is on the dashboard route with the session attached.

types.name: Session
types.description: What a successful sign-in hands back.
